retrieval_boundary: Available primary records and exact registry metadata inform vocabulary, version pins and refusal conditions. No raw page or private state is published.

sources.scope: Use the sign convention for symbolic numbers; it supplies no observed chemistry.
Use change in amount divided by stoichiometric number as terminology only.
A stoichiometric relation does not by itself establish a time-resolved physical process.
Keep relation, forward, bidirectional and equilibrium declarations distinct.
Do not infer a general kinetic law from stoichiometric coefficients.
Formula parsing is local software output, not elemental or physical verification.
Use only synthetic textual formula structure; bundled mass values are references, not measurements.
Use bounded formula structure and labelled reference-data provenance; no empirical credit.
